instruction: Add a note "DATA" into the slide and set the slide background color to blue.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct note text, 0.5 for correct background color
